title: feat(engagement): Add Enterprise Engagement & Sentiment Analytics Hub
body:
## Summary

Adds a full-featured Employee Engagement & Sentiment Analytics dashboard to PaySphere.

### 5 Production Files (2,374 lines)

1. `engagementService.ts` (483 lines) — Types, seed data, helpers, CSV export
2. `PulseSurveyCard.tsx` (294 lines) — Interactive survey card with expandable breakdown
3. `SentimentTimeline.tsx` (250 lines) — Activity feed with severity filters
4. `ActionPlanModal.tsx` (470 lines) — Create/view action plans with milestones
5. `EnterpriseEngagementSentimentPage.tsx` (877 lines) — Dashboard with 5 tabs, KPIs, sparklines

### Features
- Pulse Surveys, Department Engagement, Action Plans, Burnout Risk, Activity Feed
- CSV Export, Search and Filter, Sentiment Trend Analysis

### Route
`/enterprise/engagement-sentiment`
